title: Panchmuli Lake near Statue of Unity map
subject: Geography
caption: Map showing Panchmuli Lake and its distance from the Statue of Unity in Gujarat.
altText: A textbook-quality map on a white background that accurately shows Panchmuli Lake near the Statue of Unity in Kevadia, Gujarat. The lake is marked in blue, the statue in a red icon, and surrounding features such as the Narmada River, nearby highways, and villages are labeled. A north arrow, scale bar, and latitude/longitude grid are present, along with an inset map locating the area within Gujarat and India. Distance markers indicate the lake is about 5 km from the statue.
